name: woodshop-marketplace
description: The marketplace's Worker: plans uploaded from the game, drawn up and shared at a link.

scripts.wasm: cargo build -p plans-wasm --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && mkdir -p build && cp ../target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/plans_wasm.wasm build/plans.wasm
scripts.check: npm run wasm && wrangler types && tsc --noEmit
scripts.dev: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local && wrangler dev
scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy
